Our Mission
 
 
 
   Launched in 2012, Tinder® revolutionized how people meet, growing from 1 match to one billion matches in just two years. This rapid growth demonstrates its ability to fulfill a fundamental human need: real connection. Today, the app has been downloaded over 630 million times, leading to over 97 billion matches, serving approximately 50 million users per month in 190 countries and 45+ languages - a scale unmatched by any other app in the category. In 2024, Tinder won four Effie Awards for its first-ever global brand campaign, “It Starts with a Swipe”™
 
 
 
   The Role
 
 
  We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the strategy and execution for Tinder's recommendations ML/AI team. In this critical role, you will drive the enhancement of our recommendation systems, leveraging advanced machine learning algorithms, cutting-edge AI technologies, and sophisticated user behavior modeling to deliver highly personalized experiences for our members. You will be responsible for setting the vision, defining key metrics, and overseeing the development of innovative features that push the boundaries of personalization and engagement.
 
 
 
   The ideal candidate will have a technical background in machine learning and AI, product management experience, and a track record of using data-driven insights to drive impactful product improvements. Your expertise in both strategic planning and hands-on execution will be essential in shaping the future of our recommendation systems and ensuring they meet the evolving needs of our global user base.
 
 
 
   Where you’ll work:
 
 
  This is a hybrid role and requires in-office collaboration two times per week. This position is based in San Francisco or Palo Alto CA
 
 
  In this role, you will:
 
  Develop detailed specifications for large-scale ML/AI driven recommendations features critical to the business, guiding teams through the development process while considering the broader strategic implications of each feature.
  Partner closely with engineering and data science to improve Tinder recommendations.
  Understand markets, ecosystem effects, and user requirements in depth.
  Launch new products and features, test their performance, and iterate quickly.
  Communicate effectively with the broader product team, cross-functional partners, and senior leadership. Clearly articulate project requirements, deadlines, deliverables, and impact for critical initiatives, and achieve stakeholder buy-in.
  Represent the company’s culture and values, and drive inclusivity across teams.
  Utilize data insights and voice of the customer to drive product decisions.
 
  You’ll need:
 
  3-5 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.
  Background in recommendation systems or related ML/AI systems, ensuring user-centric outcomes and maintaining high standards of business impact.
  Demonstrated leadership experience working effectively with engineers, data scientists, and ML practitioners.
  Skills in deconstructing complex product visions into clear, actionable strategic steps, and crafting product roadmaps that align with company objectives.
  Strong written and verbal communications skills for sharing project requirements and strategic insights with cross-functional teams and leadership.
  Ability to guide decisions on whether to optimize existing features or develop new solutions, with strong skills in risk identification and management across a broad product portfolio.
 
  Nice to have:
 
  Experience working on optimizing multi-sided marketplaces.
  Degree in computer science or data science.
 
  As a full-time employee, you’ll enjoy:
 
  Unlimited PTO (with no waiting period), 10 annual Wellness Days
  Time off to volunteer and charitable donations matched up to $15,000 annually
  Comprehensive health, vision, and dental coverage
  100% 401(k) employer match up to 10%, Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)
  100% paid parental leave (including for non-birthing parents), family forming benefits, and Milk Stork, which provides access to breast milk shipping for business travel, surrogacy, and employee relocation
  Investment in your development: mentorship through our MentorMatch program, access to 6,000+ online courses through Udemy, and an annual $3,000 stipend for your professional development
  Investment in your wellness: access to mental health support via Modern Health, pet insurance, fitness membership subsidy, and commuter subsidy
  Free premium subscriptions for several Match Group apps – including Tinder Platinum!

Who We Are
   Verily is a subsidiary of Alphabet that is using a data-driven approach to change the way people manage their health and the way healthcare is delivered. Launched from Google X in 2015, our purpose is to bring the promise of precision health to everyone, every day. We are focused on generating and activating data from a variety of sources, including clinical, social, behavioral and the real world, to arrive at the best solutions for a person based on a comprehensive view of the evidence. Our unique expertise and capabilities in technology, data science and healthcare enable the entire healthcare ecosystem to drive better health outcomes.

   The Grant Manager will be the trusted point person for Verily’s NIH, ARPA-H, CDC and other government grants and agreements. In this role, you will collaborate closely with investigators, program leads and cross-functional contacts to identify, execute and submit all necessary forms, applications, reports and other documents. You will be part of Verily’s Medical and Science organization, working across the company to support government proposals of all types.
   
    Responsibilities
    
     Partner with internal program leads and investigators to develop and submit material for applications, proposals, and reporting including tracking the pipeline of awarded and in-progress grant submissions across Verily.
     Identify the administrative steps needed for each grant and navigate the internal and external stakeholders and processes needed to execute on those steps.
     Maintain Verily account access to appropriate government funding agency websites and become Verily’s go-to expert at navigating those portals.
     Partner with the Finance team to develop grant budgets, track finances and ensure that funds are managed appropriately.
     Manage communications and grant planning with key stakeholders, including grant making agencies, external partners, and internal product teams.
    
   
   
    Qualifications
   
   
    Minimum Qualifications
   
   
    
     Bachelor’s degree
     2+ years of grant administration or similar experience
     Ability to collaborate with and communicate information clearly to a diverse audience including executive stakeholders. Strong document management skills using Google Docs, Word, and Adobe PDF.
     Strong organizational skills and stellar attention to detail, including when working under tight deadlines.
    Preferred Qualifications
   
   
    
     Experience working specifically with government grants is a plus.
     Technical writing skills and experience are a plus.
     Program management experience is a plus.

Our Mission
 iSeatz provides digital commerce and loyalty tech solutions that enable travel and lifestyle bookings to global customers including American Express, Expedia, and IHG Hotels. Our proprietary platform processes over $9B per year in transactions.
 We have a history of long-term trusted relationships and innovation that drives tangible value to our customers through a customizable, scalable, and secure platform, a global third-party marketplace, and loyalty integration.
 We aspire to put our customers at the heart of every decision and exceed their expectations with best-in-class solutions and business-value innovations.
  What you’ll do
 The Senior Data Analyst reports to the Senior Director, Data Solutions and plays a critical role within the Data Solutions team, contributing to iSeatz data strategy with an emphasis on client-facing analytical support.
 In this role, you will be a strategic data partner, supporting the Client Delivery Excellence team in making data-driven decisions that drive impactful business outcomes. Collaborating with cross-functional teams—including Product and Commercial—you will identify opportunities for growth and improvement that align with both client and company goals. You’ll provide high-quality, actionable insights and ensure these are effectively communicated across all stakeholders, including executives. By fostering strong relationships with internal teams and clients, you will help meet and exceed client needs while promoting a culture of data-driven decision-making and best practices throughout iSeatz.
  Your Impact
 iSeatz & Client Collaboration:
 
  
   
    Collaborate with the client delivery excellence team and internal departments (Product, Marketing, Engineering, Client Services) to ensure data-driven decisions align with both iSeatz’s and the client’s business strategies.
   
  
   
    Serve as the main data liaison between iSeatz, the client, and relevant stakeholders, presenting findings and recommendations to leadership teams in a clear and impactful manner.
   
  
   
    Be the primary point of contact for executives, facilitating seamless communication and delivery of insights, including preparation and presentation of content in quarterly business reviews.
   
  Skillfully prioritize and manage competing projects in a fast-paced environment, ensuring clear communication and alignment between internal and external stakeholders. Anticipate and address shifting priorities, while maintaining focus on both business objectives and client satisfaction.
 
 Data Analysis & Reporting:
 
  
   
    Collect, clean, and analyze large datasets from multiple sources to identify key trends and actionable insights.
   
  
   
    Develop, maintain, and enhance dashboards and reports using tools such as Tableau to track business performance.
   
  Utilize SQL, Python, and other tools for advanced data analysis, providing strategic recommendations based on insights.
 
 Data Governance & Strategy:
 
  
   
    Contribute to data governance initiatives, ensuring data integrity, security, and privacy standards are upheld.
   
  Support the broader iSeatz data strategy, aligning client-specific projects with the company’s long-term data objectives.
 
 Mentorship & Leadership:
 
  
   
    Provide mentorship and technical guidance to junior analysts, ensuring consistent development of analytical skills within the team.
   
  Continuously seek opportunities to improve data processes and reporting, driving operational efficiencies across the organization.
 
  What you bring to the table
 
  
   
    5+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, with proven experience supporting large-scale financial institutions or complex, enterprise-level organizations.
   
  
   
    Expertise in data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and advanced SQL skills, with proficiency in Python for data manipulation and analysis.
   
  
   
    Experience with cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift) and a solid understanding of data governance, security, and privacy best practices.
   
  
   
    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on delivering actionable insights and maintaining attention to detail across multiple projects in dynamic environments with competing deadlines.
   
  
   
    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to present complex data insights effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences, including executives.
   
  
   
    Demonstrated ability to collaborate across teams, manage client relationships, and adapt communication style to diverse audiences and settings.
   
  A strong sense of professionalism when working with clients, particularly large-scale financial institutions, balanced with the ability to embrace and thrive in iSeatz's unique, innovative team culture.
 
  Bonus points
 
  
   
    Familiarity with machine learning techniques or advanced statistical analysis; e.g. time series forecasting, anomaly detection
   
  
   
    Prior experience working with large clients in a B2B environment, particularly in tech, banking, or travel sectors.
   
  
   
    Exposure to ETL processes and data pipeline management.
   
  Experience with Adobe Analytics and reporting.
 
  Location
 This role is remote-first and can be located anywhere inside the continental United States. iSeatz is a New Orleans-based company with Central Time Zone business hours, but feel free to work from your home office, from the beach, or from the cottage you rented for the summer!
  What we bring to the table
 iSeatz is among the most prominent tech employers in New Orleans. With employee engagement and community impact at the forefront of our culture, we have been named a 2020 Top Workplace by nola.com and honored as a CityBusiness Best Places to Work since 2008, including a 1st place award in 2020, at the height of a global pandemic.
 iSeatz is committed to ensuring all employees are given every opportunity to succeed and grow within and beyond their current roles and responsibilities. We work diligently to build and maintain trust among our workforce in everything we do, beginning with fostering an autonomous and thought-provoking work environment.
 Micromanagement does not have a place at iSeatz. You will be trusted to use the knowledge and experience that brought you to iSeatz in tandem with the support of your manager and those around you, as needed, to deliver a high-quality end product.
  We value a diverse workplace
 We are committed to building and maintaining a culture of support, awareness, and sensitivity about the importance and impact of our differences and leverage these differences to build a stronger iSeatz.
 If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact the People Operations Team at humanresources@iseatz.com.
  A note about joining our workforce
 At iSeatz, we’re looking for candidates who are genuinely excited about joining our fast-paced and motivated team. If you’re not enthusiastic about the opportunity to be a significant contributor; to lead with confidence, discipline, impact, thoughtfulness, innovation, and accountability; and to bring your passion and drive for this specific role to the table, we ask that you kindly refrain from applying. On the other hand, if this all sounds like you, we can’t wait to hear from you! Come help us shape the future of the travel and loyalty tech industry.

Job Summary:
 
 
 
   The primary sponsors of the BSCU are KPNC Graduate Medical Education (GME), Community Health (CH), and the Permanente Medical Group (TPMG). Our team also supports several industry-funded projects. We work on a wide spectrum of clinical areas - basically, from head to toe (e.g., adult family medicine, pediatrics, infectious disease, podiatry, social determinants of health, ophthalmology, women’s health).
  
 
 
  The ideal candidate for this position will co-lead the BSCU Analytic Programming team of programmers/analysts focused on providing high-quality programming/biostatistical collaborations with our sponsors. To support the continued growth of the BSCU Analytic Programming team, this position will serve alongside two other supervisors and under the Director of BSCU Analytic Programming Team.
  
 
 
  Our team collaborates with our clients to: a) design studies and analytical plans, b) perform feasibility analyses and power/sample size calculations, c) collect, manage, analyze data, and interpret results, d) serve as co-authors/presenters on research outcomes (peer-reviewed papers, conference presentations). This supervisor is expected to work closely with TPMG or CH principal/co-investigators, project managers at various GME residency/fellowship programs, BSCU programmers/analysts, and two other BSCU teams: Scientific Research Management and Strategic Program Operations teams.
 
  This position will be part of the BSCU and will co-lead the BSCU Analytic Programming team of programmers/analysts with two other supervisors providing: a) expert data and analytic consultation, b) technical guidance to the programmers/analysts, c) on-going support to the leadership and sponsors, and d) support in talent search and training new hires. This position also collaborates with fellow supervisors/managers in setting up guidelines/procedures to ensure that the BSCU achieve its mission ‘developing clinician-led scientific research through innovative methods and collaborative partnerships.’
  This supervisory level employee is primarily responsible for driving strategic data-informed decisions, leading data and information collection on targeted variables in an established systemic fashion, and leading data preparation for analytic efforts. This position supervises the execution of creative data analytic approaches leading to actionable outcomes, supervises the development, implementation, and automation of business and reporting solutions, leads data analysis interpretation, and leads the development of analytics and/or statistical models enabling informed business decisions.
 
   Essential Responsibilities:
 
 
  Pursues professional growth by soliciting and acting on performance feedback; building collaborative relationships; training and developing talent for growth opportunities; delegating tasks and decisions; fostering open dialogue amongst team members; supporting execution of performance management guidelines and expectations; ensuring team collaboration; and coaching to drive performance improvement.
  Supervises day-to-day activities of designated work team or unit by overseeing the execution of tactical action items; ensuring all policies and procedures are followed; delegating tasks to meet short term deliverables; overseeing the completion of work assignments; aligning team efforts and measuring progress in achieving results; identifying and recommending improvement opportunities; and removing obstacles that impact performance.
  Drives strategic data-informed decisions by consulting with senior-level clients to identify and clarify key business needs; leading the development of outcomes and process measures; leading the translation of business requirements; determining data/information needs and data collection methods; leading the development of analysis plans; reviewing the impact of business decisions on clients, customers, and/or members; working with clients and staff to identify opportunities and methods to improve efficiencies with analysis; ensuring end-users are supported and trained; and leading documentation of processes and deliverables.
  Leads data and information collection on targeted variables in an established systematic fashion by reviewing data sources; providing guidance regarding data collection methods and analysis; leading routine data refresh and update; leading the development and/or delivery of tools for electronic data collection; ensuring users are trained and supported; and leading documentation.
  Leads data preparation for analytic efforts by integrating and consolidating data; ensuring data quality and accuracy; recommending process improvements and system changes to enhance overall quality of the data; resolving or escalating issues to ensure remediation as appropriate; and reviewing final data set(s) for analysis.
  Supervises the execution of creative data analytic approaches leading to actionable outcomes by providing guidance on data design and analysis; reviewing metrics to be analyzed; defining, calculating, and validating algorithms; reviewing results of analyses; and serving as a point of escalation and technical support for descriptive, correlational, inferential, and/or predictive analyses.
  Supervises the development, implementation, and automation of business and reporting solutions by working with stakeholders to ensure their design, planning, and implementation needs are being met while ensuring consistency and coherency; reviewing results; ensuring data reports, visualizations, and/or interactive Business Intelligence (BI) reports meet established standards; reporting to stakeholders on key findings; and leading the preparation of documentation.
  Leads data analysis interpretation by reviewing findings and their application to contextual settings; reviewing insights, reports, and presentations; providing guidance and coaching to ensure a compelling story for stakeholders and to enable and influence decision making; and sharing insights with internal and/or external audiences.
  Leads the development of analytical and/or statistical models enabling informed business decisions by determining data and analytical requirements; creating and reviewing models leading to actionable insights; and testing, refining, and validating models.
 
 
   Minimum Qualifications:
 
 
  Bachelors degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Social/Physical/Life Science, Business, or related field.
  Minimum five (5) years progressive corporate, non-profit, or consulting experience, including Minimum three (3) years in data analytics or directly related field. Additional equivalent work experience in a directly related field may be substituted for the degree requirement.
  Minimum two (2) years experience in a leadership role with or without direct reports.
 
 
   Additional Requirements:
 
 
  Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities (KSAs): Negotiation; Business Planning; Written Communication; Data Extraction; Data Mining; Data Visualization Tools; Relational Database Management; Vendor Management; Delegation; Project Management

At DIRECTV our amazing people, combined with a culture that thrives on collaboration and creativity, are the foundation that create a great place to work. We empower our people to push the limits of what’s possible, driving groundbreaking innovation each and every day. We’re redefining the future of entertainment and we’re ready for you to play a big part in that future too.
 
 DIRECTV is seeking two highly skilled and experienced Sr. Directors of Marketing Advanced Analytics to lead our data-driven marketing efforts. The roles will be responsible for leveraging advanced analytics techniques to drive marketing strategy, optimize performance, and deliver actionable insights across the organization. The ideal candidates will have a strong background in data analysis, statistical modeling, and marketing analytics, with the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
 
  Position 1 – Churn Insights:
 
   This highly visible role will require someone who is comfortable living in the world between data and the business. Their team will analyze data, gather insights, and craft those churn insights into a well-polished executive friendly deck.
  Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) including call/disconnect rates, downgrades, package mix, demographics etc., and other relevant metrics that drive churn to inform product management and marketing decisions.
  Develop and deliver weekly churn insights reports to key stakeholders.
  Oversee the design and execution of complex data analysis projects, including predictive modeling, segmentation, and customer lifetime value analysis.
 
 
  Position 2 – Acquisition Insights:
 
  Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) including sales, conversions, churn, and other relevant metrics to inform product management and marketing decisions.
  Develop and deliver weekly sales headlines and insight reports to key stakeholders.
  Oversee the design and execution of complex data analysis projects, including offers and performance analytics, emerging trends, campaign analysis, forecast modeling, and sales viewership analytics.
 
 
  In both positions, here's what you’ll do:
 
  Lead the development and implementation of advanced analytics strategies to support marketing initiatives and business objectives.
  Present actionable insights and recommendations to empower cross-functional decision-makers and key stakeholders.
  Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities for data-driven improvements in marketing strategies and tactics.
  Manage and mentor a team of data analysts and data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
  Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in marketing analytics and data science.
  Ensure data quality, integrity, and compliance with relevant regulations and company policies.
  Develop and maintain strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners to drive data-informed decision-making across the organization.
 
 
  In both positions, what you’ll need to be successful:
 
  Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or related field preferred; Master's degree a plus!
  7 – 10 years of experience in marketing analytics, data science, or related field, with at least 5 years in a leadership role.
  Expert-level proficiency in SQL for database management and querying.
  Advanced skills in statistical modeling and programming using R and/or Python.
  Experience working with big data platforms such as Databricks and/or Snowflake.
  Proficiency in data visualization tools, particularly Tableau and/or PowerBI.
  Strong understanding of marketing principles, customer behavior, and business strategy.
  Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable insights for non-technical audiences.
  Proven track record of leading and mentoring high-performing analytics teams.
  Experience in developing and implementing data-driven marketing strategies that drive business growth.
  Strong project management skills and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  Demonstrated ability to influence senior leadership and drive organizational change through data-driven insights.
  May require a background check due to job duties requiring routine access to DIRECTV and DIRECTV customer’s proprietary data. Qualified applicants with arrest and conviction will be considered for employment in accordance with local ordinances and state law.
 
 
 The roles offer an exciting opportunity for a seasoned analytics professional to make a significant impact on our marketing strategy and overall business performance. The ideal candidates will combine technical expertise with strong business acumen and leadership skills to drive data-informed decision-making across the organization.
 
  These are remote positions that can be located anywhere in the United States, however Southern California location and ability to meet occasionally at DIRECTV offices in El Segundo is a plus. #LI-Remote
 
  A career with DIRECTV comes with big rewards: 
 DIRECTV's compensation structure is designed to be market-competitive and fully supports efforts to attract and retain employees. It is the company's policy to offer pay that is competitive with other employers in the local market. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location.
 
 The Base Salary range displayed below reflects the minimum and maximum target salary for each of DIRECTV's 4 (four) US Labor Market Zones. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. In addition to this base salary, total compensation will include short-term incentives, long-term incentives, 401(k) match, and other elements.
 
  DIRECTV WAGE ZONES: $154,850 - $281,060
 Low (N1): $154,850 - $232,180
 Mid (N2): $163,000 - $244,400
 High (N3): $179,300 - $268,840
 Top (N4): $187,450 - $281,060
 
 Click HERE to review information on some of the largest Designated Market Areas (DMAs). Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.
 
 Please note that the salary ranges reflect base salary only and do not include bonus or benefits - when you consider all of these together, it represents a pretty impressive total compensation package.

ABOUT US
 Fashion Nova is the world’s leading trend-to-market fashion and lifestyle brand with high-growth categories across its Women, Men, Kids and Beauty divisions. Renowned for delivering the most-wanted styles to millions worldwide, Fashion Nova earned the title of the Top 5 Most-Searched Fashion Brand on Google in 2022, alongside Louis Vuitton and Nike.
 Founder CEO Richard Saghian launched the brand in 2006, from a retail location in Los Angeles. After multiple store openings, Saghian launched the e-commerce website for Fashion Nova in 2013, pioneering a disruptive social commerce model of affordable, on-trend, size-inclusive clothing online– powered by an innovative, social media-first marketing strategy.
 Today, Fashion Nova has amassed over 40 million social media followers, with annual sales of approximately $2 billion!
 The brand’s name has been featured in chart-topping hit songs by Cardi B, Drake, 21 Savage, Saweetie, The Game, Tyga and Offset and its styles have been worn by many celebrities, artists and athletes including Meg The Stallion, Ice Spice, Chris Brown, Floyd Mayweather, Rick Ross, Kourtney Kardashian, and Kylie Jenner.
 Fashion Nova was built on the backbone of individuality and inclusiveness. Our brands are worn and celebrated worldwide by customers, celebrities, and influencers because of our uniquely creative and talented employees.
  ROLE OVERVIEW 
 We are looking for a product focused Senior Data Scientist that will be instrumental to the creation, growth, and iteration of our expanding data product suite. Using our shopper data, this person will leverage their extensive knowledge of data science and big data tools to build the algorithms that power the actionable insights used by our customers to grow their business.
  KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 
  Conduct in-depth data analysis to identify patterns, trends, and anomalies in eCommerce data, uncovering key drivers of demand
  Develop and implement time-series and machine learning models for demand forecasting, leveraging various techniques like ARIMA, Prophet, LSTM, etcetera
  Utilize statistical methodologies and data visualization techniques to present data insights and recommendations to stakeholders
  Distill complex data into actionable insights and build interactive dashboards that provide key performance indicators and business intelligence
  Collaborate with cross-functional teams (E.G., PRODUCT, MARKETING, FINANCE) to understand their data needs and translate them into data-driven solutions that drive business forward
  Design and implement A|B testing frameworks to evaluate the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and product features
  Build data pipelines and automate model training and deployment processes
  Evaluate model performance and identify areas for improvement
  Remain updated on the latest advancements in machine learning and data science
  Contribute to the development of best practices for data analysis and modeling within the team
 
 ROLE REQUIREMENTS
 
  Five plus years of hands-on experience in building and deploying machine learning models, particularly for time series forecasting
  Strong proficiency in Python and SQL. Experience with libraries like Pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, TensorFlow, and PyTorch is a plus
  Proven ability to work with large datasets and develop robust data pipelines
  Advanced understanding of statistical concepts and methodologies
  Experience working with eCommerce data is a significant advantage
  Experience in setting up A|B testing frameworks and analyzing results
  Experience working with cloud technologies like AWS and GCP is a plus
  Excellent communication and presentation skills to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences
  Experience building dashboards and visualizing data to convey actionable insights
  Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. Overview:
 
 
  Clearwater Analytics is seeking a dynamic and business-savvy Insights Manager to join our innovative team. This role is pivotal in bridging the gap between data analytics and business strategy, ensuring that our product roadmap aligns with client needs and market demands. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of financial markets, strong data analysis skills, and the ability to independently extract and analyze data to translate complex insights into actionable business strategies.
 
 
 
  Key Responsibilities:
 
 
 
  Business Insight Development:
 
 
  
   
    Collaborate closely with sales teams, product managers, and other business stakeholders to deeply understand client pain points and market opportunities.
   
  
   
    Develop and refine data-driven strategies that align with client needs, focusing on delivering actionable insights that drive business value.
   
  
   
    Act as a key contributor in defining the product vision, leveraging data insights to identify new product features and market opportunities.
   
 
 
 
  Client-Centric Data Analysis:
 
 
  
   
    Independently extract and analyze large datasets using SQL and Python.
   
  
   
    Apply your expertise in data analysis and modeling to generate insights that resonate with our clients’ business goals.
   
  
   
    Ensure that insights generated from data analysis are relevant, actionable, and aligned with the strategic needs of our clients, particularly in the insurance and corporate sectors.
   
 
 
 
  Storyteller:
 
 
  
   
    Craft and Visualize Compelling Narratives: Transform complex data insights into visually engaging stories that resonate with stakeholders and clients. Use data visualization to bring clarity and impact, ensuring insights are not just seen but truly understood.
   
  
   
    Champion Data Across Channels: Act as an advocate for data-driven insights, promoting them through marketing channels to drive awareness and interest. Inspire clients and colleagues alike by conveying the strategic importance of data in solving real business challenges.
   
  
   
    Public Speaking and Thought Leadership: Take the stage in public speaking opportunities, confidently discussing insights and trends in financial data that elevate Clearwater’s brand. By sharing expertise at industry events, position Clearwater as a leader in actionable, insight-driven solutions.
   
 
 
 
  Stakeholder Collaboration:
 
 
  
   
    Engage with cross-functional teams to ensure that data insights are seamlessly integrated into product features and client offerings.
   
  
   
    Present complex data findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring clarity and actionable recommendations.
   
  
   
    Work closely with clients to gather feedback, iterate on data models, and continuously improve the relevance and impact of the insights provided.
   
 
 
 
  Qualifications:
 
 
  
   
    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Business, Data Science, or a related field.
   
  
   
    Minimum 9 years of relevant prior experience.
   
  
   
    Proven experience in data analysis, data strategy, and working with large datasets, with a strong focus on business outcomes.
   
  
   
    Proficiency in SQL and Python, with the ability to independently extract and analyze data without needing support from a data analyst.
   
  
   
    Deep understanding of financial markets and instruments, with the ability to apply this knowledge to data-driven product development.
   
  
   
    Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate complex data insights into clear business strategies.
   
  
   
    Experience working in agile environments and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
   
  
   
    Ability to independently manage multiple projects, ensuring high-quality deliverables that meet business objectives.
   
 
 
 
  Why Clearwater Analytics?
 
 
  Join a forward-thinking team where your expertise in both business and data will directly impact the strategic direction of our products. We offer a collaborative environment where innovative ideas are valued, and professional growth is encouraged.

Overview
 
  Come join the A2D (AI, Analytics, and Data) Product Management Team as a Staff Product Manager for AI Platform at Intuit. The AI Platform team in A2D is responsible for providing development teams (including data scientists, ML engineers, data analysts, software engineers, and product managers) across Intuit the means to build, train, deploy, experiment and innovate with AI and Generative AI technologies, delivering high impact AI native product experiences and and features that delight our customers and transform the industry.
 
 
 
   We are looking for a highly technical product manager for a number of AI Platform capabilities on model inference/hosting/serving. You will play a crucial role in accelerating access to the latest AI and Generative AI models for our development teams, optimizing model performance and efficiency, as well as ensuring the highest level of operational excellence. You will work with organizations across Intuit to understand their use cases, workload requirements and provide them with the optimal AI serving solutions with speed and at scale.
 
 
   What you'll bring
  
   5+ years of product management or equivalent experience for technical platform products in a fast paced, rapidly evolving environment.
   Extensive experience working and innovating on a centralized AI/ML Platform supporting diverse applications.
   High degree of technical understanding to be able to closely collaborate with engineers, architects, and AI/ML practitioners in both strategic and tactical discussions.
   Excellent written and verbal communication skills with ability to present technical content to non-technical audiences and work with cross-functional teams to drive real business impact.
   Proven track record of working effectively with engineers, data scientists, other product managers, AI/ML practitioners, executives and vendors, with demonstrated leadership to inspire and influence beyond your immediate organization.
   Familiarity with AI/ML model development lifecycle. Familiarity with Intuit’s product offerings is a plus.

Description
 The Power Market Consultant will utilize knowledge in the electric utilities power generation and transmission industry to perform tasks for client project portfolio generation and transmission planning decisions. The consultant will perform a broad range of studies and other consulting services to help clients make decisions backed by business and engineering analysis. This role will contribute to the execution of technical studies and work with project managers to lead the technical execution for projects.
 
  Perform a broad range of studies and other consulting services to support electric utilities and asset developers to make decisions backed by business and engineering analysis regarding their investments and power supply requirements, such as integrated resource planning, market assessments, valuations and power supply RFP evaluations.
  Perform forecasts and evaluations utilizing power supply planning software such as capacity optimization and hourly dispatch software models.
  Conduct data analysis and interpretation of engineering, financial, and economic conditions and results, and subsequent technical business implications to client projects.
  Analyze life-cycle costs by developing and incorporating technical assumptions regarding capital costs, operation and maintenance costs, performance estimates, and economic assumptions and forecasts.
  Conduct technical and business-related risk assessments that evaluate impacts associated with rules implemented by regulatory agencies.
  Develop and conducts detailed financial analysis using a variety of computer-based software.
  Develop technical reports and presentations summarizing results of analysis.
  Develop client presentations, engineering reviews, financial analysis, and contract administration for the design/planning of utility systems.
  Assist project managers in business development activities including proposal development and client relationships.
  Mentor and train other employees on technical and business aspects of projects and the industry.
  Support business lines as required by clients.
  Perform other duties as assigned.
  Comply with all policies and standards.
 
 Qualifications
 
  Bachelor Degree in Engineering, Economics, Computer Science, Data Science or similar field from an ABET accredited program and 3 years of related experience or a Master's Degree in Engineering, Economics, Computer Science, Data Science, or Business and 2 years of experience
  Prior experience associated with electric utility operations, planning, or consulting is preferred.
  Experience with power supply planning software, preferably EnCompass (zonal and nodal) and Capacity Expansion (or familiarity with PROMOD, Plexos, GridView, or others).
  Experience and knowledge of general business and financial calculations including discounted cash flow analysis, net present value analysis, and internal rate of return evaluations.
  Experience and knowledge of electric power options including generation facility types, capital costs, operating costs, typical dispatch profiles, and general power system operations. Knowledge of power supply purchase agreements regarding costs and terms.
  Ability to execute various power markets / power supply planning studies.
  Knowledge of electric utility systems, power generation types, power delivery with understanding of power generation portfolio planning.
  Knowledge of numerous power market regions of the country and independent system operators such as: PJM, MISO, NEISO, SPP, CAISO, WECC, SERC, ERCOT, NYISO.
  Strong attention to detail, facilitation, team building, collaboration, organization and problem-solving skills.
  Ability to work methodically and analytically in a quantitative problem-solving environment.
  Demonstrated leadership skills.
  Proven ability to lead, educate, and train a team of consultants and analysts in regard to power market studies.
  Ability to independently solve difficult problems that require adaptation and modification of standard techniques, procedures, and criteria.
  Excellent written and oral communications skills.
  Demonstrated critical thinking skills.
  Ability to perform under pressure and tight deadlines and to be effective in on-site work environments.
  Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently, including identification of critical path items to ensure deliverable deadlines are met.
  Ability to focus on the big picture to effectively and efficiently provide services that meet client needs, while also having the ability to identify and analyze details that are critical to project outcomes.
  Willingness to learn new service offerings as client needs and the market requires changes to the service offerings provided by our group
  Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PPT).
  Ability to travel.

 JIRA

 We need an experienced BI technical project manager to drive and execute our Enterprise Data Warehouse Cloud Migration project. The scope of this project is to migrate existing EDW data foundation from SQL server and all reports, dashboards, and analytics onto Snowflake Cloud platform.
 The other objective of the project is to plan and execute change management so that our large cross functional users base (thousands) is engaged, trained, informed to adopt the system.
 As a Technical Program Manager, you will lead and drive the project to architect to build data and analytics - drive quality/consistency of data across business functions. You will use your technical and data analytics experience to facilitate and lead different workstreams within the project. You will work with our Enterprise Analytics portfolio owners, developers, analysts, lead SMEs, and cross functional business stakeholders to migrate EDW data and its reports and analytics to our Snowflake Cloud platform. You will manage the code conversion, data foundation build, and reports and analytics migration efforts. The data objects span across all business functions: finance, sales, marketing, manufacturing operations, supply chain, services, quality, and compliance.
 The TPM should be well versed with business requirements gathering, business stakeholder alignment, managing projects from concept to delivery using hybrid method of Agile and Waterfall, providing stakeholders status reports, and execute on all phases of a project. The TPM will also conduct alignment sessions with the business partners, IT counterparts, and Enterprise Analytics internal teams. He/she should be able to work independently with minimum supervision and provide a structured analytical effort to ongoing and new projects.
 Manage all aspects of program deliverables from project inception to implementation and resource oversight
 Lead the technical delivery, implementation, business change management and adoption of new scalable and reliable data analytics and business intelligence solutions for cross-department leadership and business teams
 Ensure that the project is delivered on-time, within scope and within budget
 Develop a detailed project plan and timeline to monitor and track project progress on daily and weekly basis
 Assist in the definition of project scope and objectives, involving all relevant internal stakeholders and ensuring technical feasibility
 Track and monitor daily tasks and overall progress for multiple workstreams based on functions
 Collaborate, communicate, and drive with business stakeholders and project team in all phases of project
 Manage, risks, and escalations at the right time and effectively
 Be able to manage and track deliverables assigned to each team member to ensure delivery completeness before exiting each phase gate

 Ability to work directly with business and technical teams to help solve issues, remove roadblocks, and keep all deliverables and timelines on track
 Assist in the documentation of best practices
 Measure performance using appropriate project management tools and techniques
 Build and support a collaborative relationship with internal matrix partners
 At any given time, the TPM should always know overall project health and its current issues, blockers, risks, and mitigations

About Rippling
 
 
  Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
 
 
 
   Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
 
 
 
   Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
 
 
 
   We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
 
 
  About The Role
 
  We are looking for an experienced data engineer to join our fast-growing data engineering practice. As a senior member of the team, you will be leading the design and development of data pipelines and services to enable data-driven decision-making, and power BI, ML, experimentation, and user-facing features. You are expected to work closely with stakeholders across a variety of orgs, such as Data Science, Marketing, Bizops, Revops, Finance, and adjacent data teams to drive projects forward and support the professional development of junior team members.
 
 
  Here’s an idea of some of the initiatives you could be working on:
 
 
  Building custom data pipelines using Airflow and AWS resources
  Setting up high-velocity data streaming consumers
  Regionalizing our data infrastructure and services
  Building out a data masking and suppression system for handling sensitive data
 
  What You'll Do
 
  Architect, build, and scale our data pipelines for ingesting data from internal databases and systems, and third-party tools into our warehouse
  Help build out our data lake and real-time infrastructure and tooling on AWS
  Support analytics, data science, machine learning, and business operations functions
  Monitor and maintain pipelines and infrastructure to uphold internal SLAs
 
 
   Qualifications
 
 
  8+ years of experience in data and software engineering
  Expertise in writing complex data transforms in SQL and Python
  Knowledge of data warehousing concepts around building custom ETL integrations, and building data infrastructure (SCD, CDC, Snapshots, indexing, partitioning)
  Knowledge of Data Security and Governance (nice to have)
  Experience in analytics, dimensional modeling, and ETL optimization preferred
  BS/BA in a technical field such as Computer Science or Mathematics preferred
 
 
 
   Additional Information
 
 
 
   Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com
 
 
 
   Rippling highly values in-office collaboration. Employees living within 30 miles of an office are expected to work onsite three days a week with those living 30-49.9 miles away expected to be in the office one day a week. Employees living over 50 miles away are required to relocate within 30 miles of an office. To enhance team cohesiveness, new employees are asked to work onsite three days a week for their first six months.
 
 
 
   This role will receive a competitive salary + benefits + equity. The salary for US-based employees will be aligned with one of the ranges below based on location; see which tier applies to your location here.
 
 
 
   A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.
  The pay range for this role is: 162,000 - 283,500 USD per year(US Tier 1)

About the Role
New Roads School is seeking an experienced individual to manage the Raiser’s Edge database (RE) in support of the school’s fundraising and advancement initiatives. This role’s primary responsibility is to effectively maintain donor, prospect, contacts, volunteer, and staff information in RE and to process and acknowledge gifts. Reporting to the Advancement Director, the Advancement RE Database Manager plays a critical role in ensuring database integrity and assisting the advancement team in providing excellent service to the school’s constituents by producing reports, gift acknowledgements, and data queries to support donor communications in a timely and accurate manner.
The ideal candidate will be proficient in RE database management, have the ability to connect data with donor relationships, and be collaborative and proactive, exercising sound judgment relating to confidential information and school matters.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities
Database Management:

 Manage the Raiser’s Edge database, ensuring its integrity by regularly maintaining and updating constituent records as well as by identifying and implementing regular data hygiene processes.
 Assist the advancement team in fundraising by consulting with the Director of Advancement on specific needs for translating data into usable reports.
 Regularly produce data files for hard and soft copy mailings for appeals, solicitation strategy and segmentation, board reporting, and other needs by pulling targeted lists.
 Regularly update records by attaching proposals or other materials to RE constituent records.
 Assist with preparation for advancement events by producing properly segmented mailing and electronic invitation lists and maintaining RSVPs in RE and on google sheets as needed.
 Streamline regularly provided reporting processes and respond to reporting requests promptly, generating clear and actionable insights for the development and business office teams.
 Develop, implement, maintain and document procedures for the use of the database.
 Work with Admissions Team and Registrar to obtain new and returning student data to prepare for import into Raiser’s Edge database

Reporting:

 Produce weekly Annual Fund Status Reports.
 Create and pull reports as needed for Advancement updates at Board meetings.
 Reconcile with Finance on a monthly basis.

Gift Processing and Acknowledgment:

 Receive and process gifts daily, including online transactions, mailed-in gifts, stock gifts, gifts in-kind, matching gifts, pledges, and other special donations as appropriate, ensuring accurate and timely coding and entry of contributions into the database.
 Send pledge reminders by email on a quarterly basis.
 Manages the online giving page.
 Process and mail acknowledgment letters and gift receipts twice a week, working closely with the team to uphold prompt and thoughtful communication. Produce electronic files upon request.
 Monitor for anticipated incoming donations, communicating updates to the advancement team as needed.

Administrative and Operational Support:

 Work with Registrar to regularly update student and parent constituent records
 Pull biographical and capacity data from Research Point and prepare donor profiles for new incoming families each Spring.
 Work with the Advancement Team to compile bios for advancement event briefings
 Participates in school-wide events and meetings.
 Assists the advancement team with events by supporting in ways including registering and checking in guests and helping with event set-up.
 Coordinate with development staff to support other administrative needs that contribute to overall team efficiency.

Qualifications:

 At least three to five years of professional work experience in data management.
 Proficiency in the management of the Raiser’s Edge database is required.
 Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
 Proficiency in job related computer programs, including MS Word, Excel, and Google Suite.
 Ability to perform complex mail merges.
 Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.
 Excellent interpersonal skills and the ability to enjoy getting to know the school’s diverse constituencies.
 A cooperative team approach with colleagues and a willingness to take on responsibilities that support the wider school community.
 Good sense of humor and willingness to be part of a collaborative team of advancement professionals.
 Sound judgment relating to confidential projects, school or student matters, including effective communication regarding such matters to the appropriate individuals.
 Ability to work some nights and some weekends.

Job Type: Full-time
Pay: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year
Benefits:

 403(b)
 403(b) matching
 Dental insurance
 Dependent health insurance coverage
 Flexible spending account
 Health insurance
 Life insurance
 Paid time off
 Vision insurance

Schedule:

 8 hour shift
 Evenings as needed
 Weekends as needed

Experience:

 Database management: 3 years (Preferred)
 Raiser's Edge: 2 years (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

 Santa Monica, CA 90404 (Required)

Ability to Relocate:

 Santa Monica, CA 90404: Relocate before starting work (Required)

Work Location: In person

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.
 
  DATA ANALYST, STARLINK PAYMENTS
 At SpaceX, we are leveraging our experience in building rockets and spacecraft to deploy Starlink, the world's most advanced broadband internet system. Starlink is the world's largest satellite constellation and is providing fast, reliable internet to 3M+ users worldwide. We design, build, test, and operate all parts of the system – thousands of satellites, consumer receivers that allow users to connect within minutes of unboxing, and the software that brings it all together. We've only begun to scratch the surface of Starlink's potential global impact and are looking for best-in-class engineers and analysts to rapidly accelerate our growth around the globe.
 Goal of payments team at Starlink is to create best-in-class payment experiences for its customers. As a Sr. Data Analyst on the Payments team, you will play a critical role in building and optimizing our payments strategy to achieve this goal. You will be defining and measuring key payments metrics that assess the health of Starlink payments, analyzing data to extract key insights and identifying opportunities to improve conversion rates, reduce cost and improve customer experience.
  RESPONSIBILITIES:
 
  Define and develop payment metrics and associated dashboards that quantify the health of payments at Starlink.
  Conduct deep-dive analyses of Starlink payment data to identify trends, uncover opportunities for improving conversion rates, recommend strategies to minimize payment processing costs and opportunities for growth.
  Regularly prepare reports and presentations that summarize findings, provide actionable insights, and track the effectiveness of implemented strategies.
  Support launch of new markets, payment methods and, product & feature roll-outs, experiments and larger cross-functional strategic initiatives.
  Maintain and enhance the integrity and reliability of internal and external data sources. Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders including engineering, and external processors to capture additional data and to ensure data accuracy and consistency.

Our Purpose
 Stanford Medicine is leading the biomedical revolution in precision health and medicine. We are transforming health care away from after-the-fact diagnosis to prediction and prevention and away from one-size-fits-all medicine to personalized care that empowers individuals to lead healthy lives. We are leveraging the art and science of medicine to predict and prevent disease before it strikes and cure it decisively if it does.
 To achieve our Precision Health vision, we are integrating, building, and leveraging our strengths in fundamental research, the new field of biomedical data science, and nine transformative biomedical platforms. As a learning health system, we will apply these advances in our hospitals and health care delivery systems within Stanford Health Care and Stanford Children’s Health.
  Our Values
 Fulfilling our promise to humanity requires the engagement of a diverse, creative, and collaborative team of professionals who work together to advance our research, education, and patient care mission. We strive to create a culture of inclusion and belonging to ensure all employees have the meaningful employment experience that is necessary to do their best work. We value and integrate justice, equity, diversity, and inclusion into all that we do to ensure equitable outcomes for our faculty, staff, and students. We are looking for leaders who can contribute to making excellence inclusive.
  Our Work
 The Department of Biomedical Data Science (DBDS) works collaboratively across academic disciplines, harnessing the power of biomedical informatics, biostatistics, computer science, and advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) to make fundamental discoveries and revolutionize health care. We are driven by a deep commitment to research and education and a strong desire to explore the boundaries of what is possible and thereby transform biomedical science and human health.
 As one of 19 Clinical departments and 12 Basic Science departments within the School of Medicine (SoM), DBDS has a total annual budget of $24 million, over 65 faculty and staff, and over 150 graduate students working towards Stanford’s innovative culture: cross-disciplinary interests and a collaborative approach generate a prime incubation environment for transformative thought, learnings, processes, and systems.
 The DFA must be an experienced operational leader with a strong ability to support strategic long-range planning activities. They must understand a multitude of functional areas while also demonstrating the soft skills of collaboration and working across the organization to create cultural and operational change.
  Reporting Relationships
 The Director of Finance and Administration (DFA) has a primary reporting relationship to the Chair of Department of Biomedical Data Science, with a secondary reporting relationship to the Associate Dean/Chief Financial Officer for the School of Medicine, which ensures organizational alignment between DBDS’ strategy and the broader SoM mission. The DFA partners with the chair, and other faculty and staff, to manage the financial and administrative areas of the department to include grant management, faculty and academic affairs, student affairs, external relations, and human resources. Additionally, the Director of Finance and Administration works with the Chair, and other faculty and staff, on areas of strategic planning and execution, grant portfolio development, educational programs and process excellence. The DFA partners with the Associate Dean/Chief Financial Officer, peers, and cross-functional teams to enhance the SoM’s operations in support of its research, teaching, and patient care mission.
  Job Summary
 
 
  Lead finance and administration operations for a School of Medicine's unit or units (institute and academic department). Manage staff to achieve one or more School of Medicine missions, goals and objectives. Ensure compliance in all areas. The duties of this position are typically split between 50% operational and 50% strategic activities.
 
 
 
  Develop operational and financial plans for new departmental strategic initiatives, with a focus on execution, implementation, and scaling of these initiatives, in partnership with DBDS Chair, DBDS Executive Director, Associate Dean/CFO, CIO, CTO, and direct and indirect reports. New initiatives include the development of a new center in the department focused on AI in precision medicine, with DFA providing support of strategic planning and execution, with oversight of center’s operations and finances, and its coordination with partners including SOM/SHC’s Technology Digitals Solutions (TDS).
 
 
 
  Partner with senior leadership on departmental affairs and advocate the unit's needs and goals to internal and external parties. Evaluate business processes and operational and/or financial effectiveness Working with the senior administration, develop or revise current processes where needed for better efficiencies and outcomes, participate in execution and oversee implementation. Develop annual operational business plans, including financial modeling, to support departmental goals.
 
 
 
  Analyze department needs and make recommendations to senior leaders for changes in staffing, facilities, health and safety compliance, finance, technology and/or administrative functions. Work with the Chair and /or Dean's Office regarding resources to support faculty activities and interests.
 
 
 
  Responsible for overall fiscal wellness and financial operations. Develop and monitor consolidated budget and analyze research funding; implement financial growth and sustainability strategies.
 
 
 
  Recommend and develop strategies for general cost containment, strategic investments, and growth management.
 
 
 
  Direct department operations. Our Purpose

Stanford Medicine is leading the biomedical revolution in precision health and medicine. We are transforming health care away from after-the-fact diagnosis to prediction and prevention and away from one-size-fits-all medicine to personalized care that empowers individuals to lead healthy lives. We are leveraging the art and science of medicine to predict and prevent disease before it strikes and cure it decisively if it does.

To achieve our Precision Health vision, we are integrating, building, and leveraging our strengths in fundamental research, the new field of biomedical data science, and nine transformative biomedical platforms. As a learning health system, we will apply these advances in our hospitals and health care delivery systems within Stanford Health Care and Stanford Children’s Health.

Our Values

Fulfilling our promise to humanity requires the engagement of a diverse, creative, and collaborative team of professionals who work together to advance our research, education, and patient care mission. We strive to create a culture of inclusion and belonging to ensure all employees have the meaningful employment experience that is necessary to do their best work. We value and integrate justice, equity, diversity, and inclusion into all that we do to ensure equitable outcomes for our faculty, staff, and students. We are looking for leaders who can contribute to making excellence inclusive.

Our Work

The Department of Biomedical Data Science (DBDS) works collaboratively across academic disciplines, harnessing the power of biomedical informatics, biostatistics, computer science, and advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) to make fundamental discoveries and revolutionize health care.      Experience in creating dashboards and reports using tools such as Tableau, Looker, or equivalent.

     Master’s degree in a relevant technical or financial field.

 Location: FabFitFun is based in Beverly Hills, CA. This position is eligible to work hybrid from our HQ (preferred) or is eligible for remote.
  What You'll Do:
 Project Leadership
 
  Lead the development of generative AI solutions from the ground up, including strategic planning and technical execution.
  Act as a thought leader to align the chatbot's capabilities with company goals and provide recommendations for best practices.
 
 Technical Development
 
  Design and implement customer-facing chat experiences integrated into our platforms, including features such as:
  
   
    Personalized product descriptions.
    Customer-facing chatbots to improve user engagement, including features that enable users to manage their account, billing, purchasing, and order status.
    Agents for managing complex internal workflows.
   
  Develop, optimize, and maintain backend and application code in Python and Java to support chatbot functionalities.
  Craft and fine-tune effective prompts for generative AI use cases, iteratively improving quality by conducting experiments.
  Deploy and manage chatbot components in production, ensuring their stability, scalability, and performance.
 
 Quality Assurance
 
  Develop or procure a comprehensive solution to validate and monitor the quality of chat interactions, ensuring the chatbot meets performance, reliability, and user experience standards.
 
 Collaboration & Process
 
  Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define requirements and align project goals.
  Participate in weekly sprints to ensure timely planning, execution, and review of tasks.
  Establish standards and best practices through comprehensive documentation and training.
 
 What You'll Bring:
 
  1 year of experience working with foundational LLM models, including deploying, fine-tuning, and integrating these models into production environments.
  5+ years of experience as a software engineer with a strong focus on backend development.
  Proficiency in Python or Java.
  Understanding of data science concepts to support performance evaluation.
  Designed, built, and operated domain-driven backend systems at scale.
  Worked in agile environments, including kanban and hybrid systems.
  Simplified complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and curious teammates.
  Automated systems for long-term, stable production operation with minimal human intervention.
  Driven continuous delivery, ensuring small and frequent deployments.
  Tuned observability across the stack to enhance monitoring and reliability.
  Worked on prompt engineering, experimenting with different approaches to enhance AI output.
 
 Preferred AI Experience
 
  Deployed and integrated AI models, specifically LLM foundational models, into real-world applications.
  Worked with LLM agent architectures like AutoGen, MetaGPT, CrewAI, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGPT, and Swarm.
  Developed or worked with traditional chatbot frameworks such as Dialog Flow, Rasa, Microsoft Bot Framework, and Wit.ai.
  Fine-tuned large language models to improve application-specific performance.
  Implemented AI safety practices and guardrails to ensure ethical and responsible AI usage.
 
 The expected base salary range for this position is $150K to $190K + bonus. The compensation package will also include an initial equity grant, in addition to a range of generous medical, dental, vision and other perks & benefits. Compensation decisions are determined using a variety of job-related factors such as skill set, geographic location, market demands, experience, and education / certifications. If we extend an offer for employment, we will consider all individual qualifications.
 
   What You'll Get! The Benefits & Perks of FabFitFun...
  
   Uncapped / Generous PTO
   Medical, Dental & Vision with competitive coverage options and plans
   401K & 401K Match
   Pet insurance for any FFF furry friends via Nationwide - covers 90% expenses
   Complimentary annual FFF subscription with seasonal $25 credit for e-commerce flash sales
   Donation matching program via BrightFunds, where the company matches up to $500 charitable donations per employee

  Your information will be handled in accordance with our Workforce Member Privacy Notice: https://legal.fabfitfun.com/#workforce-member-privacy-notice

Founded in 2015, Acubed is the Silicon Valley innovation center of Airbus. As a global leader in aerospace, Airbus aims to make things fly. Our mission is to provide a lens into the future for the industry, transforming risk into opportunity to build the future of flight now. At Acubed, we strive to propel innovation to market faster, broaden the talent pool in emerging aerospace careers and simultaneously help drive a culture change across Airbus.
  WAYFINDER
 Our Wayfinder team is building scalable, certifiable autonomy systems to power the next generation of commercial aircraft. Our team of experts is driving the maturation of machine learning and other core technologies for autonomous flight; we are creating a reference architecture that includes hardware, software, and a data-driven development process to allow aircraft to perceive and react to their environment. Autonomous flight is transforming the transportation industry, and our team is at the heart of this revolution.
  The Opportunity/Role Description
 As Staff Machine Learning Engineer, you'll lead the technical execution of our ML pipelines with a focus on improving the overall end-to-end perception pipeline. You'll have the freedom to be hands-on, drive innovation, and maintain an agile work environment that fosters collaboration and creativity.
  Role Responsibilities
 
  Design and develop cutting-edge ML models, architectures, and pipelines for vision-based flight capabilities in commercial aircraft
  Drive technical direction, providing guidance to the team and ensuring alignment with business objectives
  Conduct rigorous evaluations of ML models, assessing effectiveness, efficiency
  Write high quality, product level code that is easy to maintain and test following standard methodologies
  Collaborate with multiple teams, including Data/Labeling, Simulation, Verification, and Validation, as well as teams in the global Airbus Organization
  Keep track of the latest innovation in academia and the open-source community and quickly prototype new projects on Vision and LLM/Foundation model useful to Airbus
 
 Qualifications
 
  Master's degree (or equivalent industry experience) in computer science, or a related discipline
  11+ years of experience in developing and leading software and system design for aerospace, robotics or related fields
  6+ years of industry experience working as a CV/ML perception software engineer in the field of autonomous vehicles or related fields
  Experience in developing on or using deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX, etc.)
  Experience in deploying ML models to production
  Extensive experience in Python
  Strong communication skills and presentation abilities
 
 Nice to Have
 
  PhD degree in Computer Science or a similar discipline, or an equivalent amount of machine learning experience
  Passion for aviation and autonomous systems
  Experience with LLM, RL, and other emerging ML technologies
  Proficiency in C+
 
 Compensation:
 The estimated salary range for this position is $199,000 to $244,000 annually, plus a target bonus and a comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k), and flight training. Your exact compensation will be determined by your location and experience.
  Why Join Us? Be a part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and innovation. At Acubed, your contributions will directly impact our digital future. We welcome diverse perspectives and are committed to fostering an inclusive environment.
 
  Please Note that Acubed does not offer sponsorship of employment-based nonimmigrant visa petitions for this role.

description:
Overview
 
  In this role, you’ll be embedded inside a vibrant team of data scientists. You’ll be expected to help conceive, code, and deploy data science models at scale using the latest industry tools. Important skills include data wrangling, feature engineering, developing models, and testing metrics.
 
 
   What you'll bring
  
   BS, MS, or PhD degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
   6+ years of experience
   Knowledgeable with Data Science tools and frameworks (i.e. Python, Scikit, NLTK, Numpy, Pandas, TensorFlow, Keras, R, Spark).
   Basic knowledge of machine learning techniques (i.e. classification, regression, and clustering).
   Understand machine learning principles (training, validation, etc.)
   Knowledge of data query and data processing tools (i.e. SQL)
   Computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, performance complexity, and implications of computer architecture on software performance (e.g., I/O and memory tuning).
   Software engineering fundamentals: version control systems (i.e. Git, Github) and workflows, and ability to write production-ready code.
   Experience deploying highly scalable software supporting millions or more users
   Experience with GPU acceleration (i.e. CUDA and cuDNN)
   Experience with integrating applications and platforms with cloud technologies (i.e. AWS and GCP)
   Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to conduct meetings and make professional presentations, and to explain complex concepts and technical material to non-technical users
  
 
 
   How you will lead
  
   Discover data sources, get access to them, import them, clean them up, and make them machine learning-ready.
   Work with data scientists to create and refine features from the underlying data and build pipelines to train and deploy models.
   Partner with data scientists to understand, implement, refine and design machinelearning and other algorithms.
   Run regular A/B tests, gather data, perform statistical analysis, draw conclusions on the impact of your models.
   Work cross functionally with product managers, data scientists and product engineers, and communicate results to peers and leaders.
   Explore new technology shifts in order to determine how they might connect with the customer benefits we wish to deliver

Overview

In this role, you’ll be embedded inside a vibrant team of data scientists. You’ll be expected to help conceive, code, and deploy data science models at scale using the latest industry tools. Important skills include data wrangling, feature engineering, developing models, and testing metrics.

What you'll bring

  • BS, MS, or PhD degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 6+ years of experience
  • Knowledgeable with Data Science tools and frameworks (i.e. Python, Scikit, NLTK, Numpy, Pandas, TensorFlow, Keras, R, Spark).
  • Basic knowledge of machine learning techniques (i.e. classification, regression, and clustering).
  • Understand machine learning principles (training, validation, etc.)
  • Knowledge of data query and data processing tools (i.e. SQL)
  • Computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, performance complexity, and implications of computer architecture on software performance (e.g., I/O and memory tuning).
  • Software engineering fundamentals: version control systems (i.e. Git, Github) and workflows, and ability to write production-ready code.
  • Experience deploying highly scalable software supporting millions or more users
  • Experience with GPU acceleration (i.e. CUDA and cuDNN)
  • Experience with integrating applications and platforms with cloud technologies (i.e. AWS and GCP)
  • Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to conduct meetings and make professional presentations, and to explain complex concepts and technical material to non-technical users

How you will lead

  • Discover data sources, get access to them, import them, clean them up, and make them machine learning-ready.
  • Work with data scientists to create and refine features from the underlying data and build pipelines to train and deploy models.
  • Partner with data scientists to understand, implement, refine and design machinelearning and other algorithms.
  • Run regular A/B tests, gather data, perform statistical analysis, draw conclusions on the impact of your models.
  • Work cross functionally with product managers, data scientists and product engineers, and communicate results to peers and leaders.
  • Explore new technology shifts in order to determine how they might connect with the customer benefits we wish to deliver
